name: Utility
author: Motion Audio
description: The everyday tools in one: gain, balance, width (0 = mono), and each side's polarity. The free utility.
code:
@block
g = db2gain(gain)
@sample
l = inL * g * (flipL > 0.5 ? -1 : 1)
r = inR * g * (flipR > 0.5 ? -1 : 1)
m = (l + r) * 0.5
s = (l - r) * 0.5 * width
l = m + s
r = m - s
outL = l * (balance > 0 ? 1 - balance : 1)
outR = r * (balance < 0 ? 1 + balance : 1)
